text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent weekly newspaper Mmegi om Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Minister of Commerce and Industry George Kgoroba appeals to diplomats to urge their governments to support a proposal to be presented to CITES (The International Convention for Trading in Endangered Species) in June next year that Botswana be allowed limited and regulated trade in ivory and other elephant products.

- Southern African Development Community executive secretary Kaire Mbuende, says the amount of investment that has been attracted to the region so far is disappointing. There needed to be a marked improvement in the marketing of SADC.
